subject: MLB awards voting (BBWAA)
query: how is the mlb mvp voted
title: How is the MLB MVP voted? 30 writers, results Nov. 12
answer: The MLB MVP is chosen by 30 members of the Baseball Writers' Association of America, two from each big league city, voting separately for the American and National League. Each lists 10 players; first place earns 14 points, then 9 down to 1. The 2026 MVPs will be announced Nov. 12.
body:
The same writers' group picks the other main awards, with 30 voters each. The Cy Young ballot has five places worth 7, 4, 3, 2 and 1 points. Rookie of the Year and Manager of the Year ballots have three places worth 5, 3 and 1. Writers cannot split a place between two players, and AL cities vote only on AL awards, NL cities only on NL awards. Ballots are turned in before the postseason begins, so October heroics do not count.

The 2026 schedule runs across one week on MLB Network: Rookie of the Year on Monday, Nov. 9, Manager of the Year on Nov. 10, Cy Young on Nov. 11 and MVP on Thursday, Nov. 12. Three finalists are named in advance for each award, and full vote totals are published after each announcement.
in_the_news: MLB's 2026 award winners are announced Nov. 9-12, ending with the American and National League MVPs on Nov. 12.

faq.q: When is the 2026 MLB MVP announced?
faq.a: Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026, on MLB Network. Cy Young is Nov. 11, Manager of the Year Nov. 10 and Rookie of the Year Nov. 9.

faq.q: Who votes for the MLB MVP?
faq.a: Thirty members of the Baseball Writers' Association of America, two from each MLB city.

faq.q: How many points is a first-place MVP vote?
faq.a: 14 points. Second place is worth 9, then 8 down to 1 point for 10th.

faq.q: Do playoffs count in MVP voting?
faq.a: No. Ballots are submitted before the postseason starts, so only the regular season counts.
